summary: The performance gap reproduced on the prepared base and remains at exact candidate 2c6b394d75deb3f19d660f762b2ab02fd60c4eea. The candidate adds only reports and benchmarks, with no implementation change.

tests.what_was_measured: Base GPU accuracy against Torch and convolution/equivalent-GEMM event-time ratios for three issue-derived and three adversarial boundary shapes; ratios 1.47x-1.93x.
Exact-candidate GPU regression with independent Torch convolution references and all shipped tiles; convolution/GEMM ratios 1.51x, 1.45x, and 1.66x.
Candidate accuracy and timings for M/tile boundaries, output-channel tails, and stride-2 spatial tails; all accurate at rtol=atol=2e-2, ratios 1.76x-1.96x.
Eight focused convolution tile regression cases on the candidate.

gpu_execution_evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950 device 0; ROCm SMI unique ID 0x5fb42ff90866060e recorded before and after the candidate benchmark.
remaining_limitations: No production shape set or acceptance threshold was supplied; Torch GEMM is a compute-density reference with different memory access; only MI350X/gfx950 was verified; candidate contains no implementation fix or compiler/ISA evidence.
